notes: Known-object prompt overrides for PhysX-Anything bedroom_4 VLM experiments. These are inference-time constraints, not training data.

parts.name: Mattress
parts.description: One contiguous rectangular soft mattress on top of the bed frame.

parts.name: Pillow cluster
parts.description: All visible pillows merged into one contiguous soft pillow cluster at the head of the bed.

parts.name: Headboard
parts.description: One vertical wooden headboard behind the mattress.

parts.name: Bed frame/base
parts.description: The complete rigid support frame and base, including slats, rails, drawers, and uncertain thin structures merged into one part.

bedroom4_bed01.part_merge_policy: Use one complete bed asset. Merge slats, drawers, thin surfaces, rails, and uncertain fragments into bed frame/base. Merge all pillows into one pillow cluster unless they are very clearly separable. Avoid isolated shards.
bedroom4_bed01.static_joint_policy: A bed is static furniture here. Put all parts in a single fixed group with Type: E; do not invent drawers, hinges, or movable joints.
bedroom4_bed01.notes: The desired output is a complete bed, not a set of separate broken bed pieces.

parts.name: Lampshade
parts.description: One contiguous shade surrounding the lamp head.

parts.name: Stem/stand
parts.description: The narrow rigid vertical support connecting shade and base.

parts.name: Base
parts.description: The stable rigid bottom base of the table lamp.

parts.name: Bulb or light diffuser
parts.description: Small internal light diffuser or bulb region, merged if uncertain.

bedroom4_lamp02.part_merge_policy: Describe only the lamp. If the supporting furniture is visible, treat it as background and exclude it. Merge tiny uncertain lamp details into stem/stand or lampshade rather than creating floating fragments.
bedroom4_lamp02.static_joint_policy: A table lamp is a rigid static object here. Put all parts in a single fixed group with Type: E.
bedroom4_lamp02.notes: The crop was previously misread as a table; force the target to remain a lamp.

parts.name: Top surface
parts.description: The flat top board of the nightstand.

parts.name: Cabinet body
parts.description: The main rigid box-shaped body of the nightstand.

parts.name: Drawer or front panel
parts.description: Visible drawer face or front panel; tiny handles are merged into this part.

parts.name: Legs or base
parts.description: The support legs or plinth base merged as one structural support part.

bedroom4_nightstand02.part_merge_policy: Keep the nightstand as one complete bedside table asset. Merge tiny handles and ambiguous thin details into drawer/front panel. Do not create separate shards.
bedroom4_nightstand02.static_joint_policy: Use a single fixed group with Type: E unless a drawer front is clearly visible and should be represented as a sliding group.
bedroom4_nightstand02.notes: The crop was previously misread as a safe; keep it as a bedside table/nightstand.
